principle: a credential surface is any value used to prove identity or provision a reusable secret, not only columns named clave

surfaces.target: Auth0 username/password; Campus stores AUTH_SUB/state only
surfaces.migration: explicit per-account migration or reset; clear plaintext only after IdP identity is confirmed

surfaces.risk: readable reusable prospect/free-user credential and source copied into USUARIOS during activation/matriculation
surfaces.target: no password persisted during public enrollment; approved account uses managed IdP establishment flow
surfaces.migration: pending/unactivated records must not be copied in bulk; require establishment/reset when converted to managed identity

surfaces.risk: student code is a predictable/reused identifier treated as a password even though it is not named clave
surfaces.target: remove authentication meaning from CODIGO; preserve it only as academic/student identifier
surfaces.migration: legacy student must establish a managed password; once migrated, cédula+CODIGO fallback must never authenticate that account

surfaces.path: _crearFilaEnDatosV2 sets clave = codigoEst while CODIGO is also written
surfaces.source_comment: clave en DATOS = mismo valor que CODIGO; la clave elegida por el usuario va a USUARIOS, no a DATOS
surfaces.risk: a field named clave stores the same legacy student code used as a credential fallback, reinforcing the false treatment of CODIGO as a secret
surfaces.target: DATOS.clave must not store CODIGO or any reusable authentication secret; CODIGO remains non-secret academic identifier
surfaces.migration: inventory and neutralize legacy DATOS.clave values after the cédula+CODIGO authentication fallback is removed; preserve CODIGO itself as identifier

surfaces.credential: generated fallback an#### when PROSPECTOS.CLAVE is absent
surfaces.source_behavior: clavePropuesta = 'an' + random four digits; comment instructs admin to communicate it by WhatsApp
surfaces.risk: short predictable temporary password is generated by Campus, stored readably and operationally communicated to the student
surfaces.target: activation never generates or communicates a reusable password; it creates an IdP account-establishment/invitation state instead
surfaces.migration: remove fallback before managed-identity activation goes live; existing accounts created this way migrate/reset like any other legacy account

surfaces.source_behavior: the newer generarMatricula endpoint falls back to codigoEst as password; router still exposes both generarMatricula and activarEstudiante
surfaces.risk: a public/known academic identifier becomes a reusable login secret and is stored readably in USUARIOS
surfaces.target: generarMatricula must never provision credentials; it must create/attach managed IdP establishment state while CODIGO remains non-secret
surfaces.migration: remove this fallback together with activarEstudiante before managed-identity provisioning goes live; accounts created this way require migration/reset

surfaces.path: getUsuario is additionally wrapped by CS21A72/CS21A139 demo layers; handled under SEC-004
surfaces.risk: must not be confused with a real identity migration path or bypass the future identity-state gate
surfaces.target: demo remains centrally read-only or isolated; no production-authority Auth0 identity; real-account auth-state checks remain fail-closed
surfaces.migration: out of SEC-001 account migration; preserve SEC-004 boundary

closure_rules: no active USUARIOS account authenticates against readable clave
no prospect/free-user path authenticates against PROSPECTOS readable password
no student authenticates with NUM_CEDULA + CODIGO
DATOS CODIGO remains a non-secret identifier only
DATOS.clave does not duplicate CODIGO or contain reusable authentication material
activarEstudiante never generates, displays, stores or instructs staff to communicate an an####-style or other reusable temporary password
generarMatricula never uses codigoEst or another academic identifier as a password and never copies PROSPECTOS.CLAVE into a reusable Campus credential
all account-creation paths enter a managed IdP establishment state without Campus owning the new password
no readable password-like values remain in active credential stores
migrated accounts cannot fall back to any legacy credential surface
all legacy authentication/provisioning branches have an explicit removal or expiry gate
demo authentication is evaluated separately under SEC-004 and cannot grant authority to real accounts
